column3: Vejeeta needed two hundred and fifty episodes to admit that, without breaking.
He was the prince. Goku was the low-class one. And Goku kept passing him. Still second.
Then, in episode two eighty, watching Goku fight, he finally says it. Kakarot is better.
And it doesn't break him. Because Goku was never racing him. He was racing his own limits.
In one study, kids who measured against their past selves felt pride, without the urge to be on top.
